fullContentHtml:
Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan High Court, Jodhpur (RHC) has released the Admit Card for the post of Stenographer. This recruitment was released for 163 posts. Applications for the Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 22 July 2026, to 10 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 28 October 2026 – 03 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 July 2026
  • Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 28 October 2026 – 03 November 2026
  • Admit Card : 12 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, MBC, Other State : Rs. 750/-
  • OBC (NCL), MBC (NCL), EWS : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 450/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Admit Card 2026?

Rajasthan High Court Stenographer Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
